title: shelves are data, and we try several to learn which ones help

criteria.text: Every other view (a search, an ask) opens the same way, then one quiet end line, then everything else; no end line when the block is empty

criteria.text: A shelf is a row of data: name, query, lead time, order, place (fixed or rotating), season dates, on/off; changing one needs no deploy
criteria.note: `public.shelves` carries id, name, query, lead_days, place, fixed_order, season_start/end, kind and enabled; anyone reads the enabled rows, nobody writes through the API, so a change is a row edit [V migration 20261101200000]. Checked: `[guards F121.2]` in `tests/shelves-db.test.ts:84` asserts the columns, the on/off read and the write refusal; also `:174` reads each seeded query through the real `browse_feed`. `tests/shelves-db.test.ts` and the unit suites run in CI against local Supabase [A ci.yml, as other reports]. Reviewed: #1159 `Reviewed by: a second session`, no review-skipped [V]. Shipped: deploy-health green on 9ef8bb23 [V]; the migration applied to production first (Apply migrations run on branch f121-shelves, 2026-11-01, success) [V]. Smoked unknown: a data property, not a route.
